description: F15: a repository whose core.fsmonitor names a command (here one that writes a file beside the repositories) does not run it under dirty or drift: every git call passes -c core.fsmonitor=false. The step snapshot fails the case if the file appears.

write.proj/alpha/.git/config:
[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	bare = false
	fsmonitor = "echo pwned > {ROOT}/PWNED-alpha.txt; false"
write.repo/.git/config:
[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	bare = false
	fsmonitor = "echo pwned > {ROOT}/PWNED-repo.txt; false"
